root_cause: A reviewer model was capped at max_tokens=512 for a JSON response with a free-form reason field. Responses were truncated mid-string, all three JSON parse attempts failed, and the fallback parser returned a raw fragment as the verdict reason.

details.rule: When an LLM's output is parsed as structured data, set max_tokens to at least 2x the expected payload size and cap every free-form field with an explicit character limit in the system prompt. Add a partial-JSON extractor as a last-resort parser.
